routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: This page couldn’t load. It may be a temporary connection problem — try again in a moment.
routeError.reference: Reference {digest} — quote this when reporting the problem.

pageError.title: This page couldn’t load
pageError.body: Something went wrong fetching this page. It may be a temporary connection problem. Other pages should still work.

mentees.title: Your mentees live here
mentees.body: Up to five teachers you guide. Tap to see how each one is progressing through their four quarterly check-ins.

observationCycles.title: Observation cycles
observationCycles.body: Every time you watch a lesson — live or by video — it's a cycle. Five steps: pre-form, observe, video, post-form, sign-off.

pendingReviews.title: Pending video reviews
pendingReviews.body: Teachers upload their lessons. Aim to give written feedback within 48 hours.

repository.title: The repository
repository.body: Everything about every school, class, subject, lesson and reading material. Searchable. Browse it like a library.

helpTap.title: Help is always here
helpTap.body: Tap the ? button to look up any term or message the programme team. It sits here on a computer and at the bottom right on a phone. On a keyboard, ? opens it too.

teacherPhase.title: Your current phase
teacherPhase.body: You're in Phase 2 — Application. Modules, lessons, readings and your cohort sessions all live here.

teacherObservations.title: Your observations
teacherObservations.body: Each cycle starts with a small Pre-form, then your lesson is watched (or you upload a video), then your mentor writes feedback.

teacherVideo.title: Send a lesson video
teacherVideo.body: Forward it via WhatsApp (easiest on slow networks) or upload here. Resumes if your connection drops.
teacherVideo.bodyWithoutWhatsApp: Upload it here, from a phone or a computer. Resumes if your connection drops.

teacherHelp.title: Help is always here
teacherHelp.body: Stuck on a word or a step? Tap the ? button — here on a computer, bottom right on your phone — to look it up or to message the programme team.

adminRepository.title: Repository = your records
adminRepository.body: Schools, classes, subjects, teachers, sessions, reading material. Everything cross-linked. Start here for any look-up.

adminTables.title: Operational tables
adminTables.body: Add or update teachers, schools and pairings. Every change is logged.

adminAudit.title: Audit log
adminAudit.body: Every action — logins, uploads, gate attempts — is recorded here. Read-only, kept for seven years.

adminHelp.title: Help is always here
adminHelp.body: Press ? any time, or use this ? button, to open the help panel: every term explained, plus the helpdesk contacts.

observerCycles.title: Your observation cycles
observerCycles.body: The cycles you are assigned to. Read the teacher's pre-form, watch the lesson live or by video, then file your observer form.

observerTeachBack.title: Teach-back reviews
observerTeachBack.body: Teachers record themselves teaching an RTT lesson. Watch each one and mark it reviewed.

settingsForm.watermarkBody: Always on, for every viewer. It identifies who was watching if a recording of the screen is shared.
settingsForm.footageNote: All session footage is confidential and downloads are disabled at the player level.
settingsForm.languageNote: Used for UI labels and notifications. Content (lesson titles, observation notes) is not auto-translated.
